video_title: Bennett Stirtz Had ZERO D1 Offers… Then Became an NBA First-Round Pick | 16th Pick | EP3

quotes.speaker: Bennett Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Bennett Stirtz on his unconventional path to the NBA draft
quotes.excerpt: Had a crazy journey to get here. Was Division II two years ago, so wasn't high recruited.
quotes.quote: Had a crazy journey to get here. Was Division II two years ago, so wasn't high recruited. It's pretty overlooked, so it's something that I will always carry with me is this chip on my shoulder.

quotes.speaker: Roger Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Roger Stirtz on Bennett's ability to understand winning basketball
quotes.excerpt: He always understood the moment. He understood what it took to win.
quotes.quote: He always understood the moment. He understood what it took to win, and he was probably a player that understood that more than any player I've ever had before and seen because even at a young age, he knew what needed to be done and how it needed to be done in order to win. And he had the ability to do that and make his teammates better.

quotes.speaker: Ben McCollum
quotes.summary_phrase: Ben McCollum on Bennett Stirtz's readiness for the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think he's ready to play. So wherever he gets drafted, he's ready to go.
quotes.quote: I think he's ready to play. So wherever he gets drafted, he's ready to go. I think some people get really excited about just hearing your name called, and he'll be excited because he's earned that right and opportunity. But more importantly, the second it gets called, he's going to want to go to work, and that's probably his focus right now.

quotes.speaker: Bennett Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Bennett Stirtz on building relationships and fitting into a team
quotes.excerpt: It starts with creating relationships and knowing what the team needs out of me.
quotes.quote: It starts with creating relationships and knowing what the team needs out of me. So making it clear, talking to Coach Dagnol, talking to Sam, and seeing what they want from me and just being myself out there because I'm pretty versatile and I can do whatever they need me to do.
